catalogue.orientation: Landscape-oriented composition within the portrait page

formalObservation.Composition:
The drawing is organized horizontally.

Principal visual elements:

- large left-hand vertical/organic figure
- broad central body-like form
- right-hand figure with rounded upper structure
- several appendages extending from central forms
- dense horizontal ground band along the bottom
formalObservation.Primary Forms:
- Left vertical figure
- Central large body
- Right figure
- Lateral appendages
- Lower ground structure
formalObservation.Visible Anatomical / Figure-like Feature:
Left figure:

- eye-like marking
- mouth
- triangular tooth-like marks
- elongated vertical projection
- multiple small appendages

Right figure:

- eye-like marking
- projecting facial structure
- mouth with downward-pointing tooth-like forms
- rounded upper forms
- elongated lower extensions

Central body contains several smaller repeated forms.

Species or creature identities are not assigned.
formalObservation.Structural Forms:
- Broad horizontal central body
- Vertical supports
- Curved appendages
- Lower horizontal ground
- Rounded upper structures
- Rectangular/linear background forms
formalObservation.Repeated Forms:
- Circular / oval forms
- Small rounded appendages
- Triangular tooth-like marks
- Parallel hatching
- Horizontal bands
formalObservation.Mark-Making:
Dominant technique: parallel directional hatching.

Also:

- thick outer contours
- dense interior hatching
- lighter linear marks
- dark filled passages
- repeated short strokes

The lower ground area is particularly densely worked and creates a strong horizontal base.
formalObservation.Figure–Ground Relationship: Figures remain clearly legible against the paper, although surrounding hatching creates visual connections between them.
formalObservation.Formal Language:
- Strong horizontal organization.
- Multiple figure-like units share a common ground.
- Large central mass dominates.
- Organic contours are juxtaposed with geometric/rectilinear structures.
- Repeated circular and oval units occur throughout.
- Dense ground hatching establishes a strong compositional anchor.
